**Top reasons users are unhappy (highest negative‑share theme)**  

- **Playback and UI glitches** – This theme accounts for 98 % negative sentiment across 481 feedback items, the highest negative share in the dataset【0】.  
  - Users complain about **forced premium upgrades to play specific songs**【1】.  
  - The **free tier is plagued by excessive ads**, with some saying ad time dominates the listening experience (≈40 % ads)【1】.  
  - General frustration with the app’s **instability and poor UI**, leading some reviewers to rate it “0 stars” and label it “10 apps to hear music”【1】.  

These three recurring pain points—mandatory premium for full playback, ad‑heavy free experience, and overall app instability—are the primary drivers of dissatisfaction.
